text:
mira: Heads-up — holiday promo forecast shows a bigger spike than our Q4 baseline. Projection: ~350k GPU hours over 2 weeks, peak qps ~2.2x baseline. Need a quick pass on reservoir + burst guardrails for us-west1 and eu-west1.

alex_k: Do we have per-region breakdowns? What's current burst cap/steady ratio?

mira: Per-region: us-west1 ~50% of load, eu-west1 ~30%, apac ~20%. Current policy: burst_cap=0.25 (25% of pool), steady=0.75, reservoir_window=10m, cooldown=120s.

sam_t: If peak qps is 2.2x, we'll exhaust burst within ~18 hours without reservation. Suggest increasing reservoir to hold 12 hours equivalent of steady traffic and reduce instantaneous burst_cap to 15%.

alex_k: agree with lowering burst_cap. Also recommend bumping prewarm pool + shorter cooldown for scale-up: cooldown=60s only for scales >+30%.

devops-bot: [metric alert] us-west1 GPU utilization trending 85% -> 93% in last 3h, queue latency p95=420ms, pending_requests=340.

jordan_p: flag — eu-west1 has network egress caps on Fridays from partner infra. If we shift more capacity there we'll hit throttles. Need routing policy with egress-aware fallback.

finance_ella: rough cost calc: additional reservation + prewarm for 2 weeks ~estimated $48k. If we keep current burst policy and trigger on-demand, estimated extra spend ~$72k. (ballpark)

sam_t: here's a quick policy snippet for testing:
```
{ "policy": "holiday-guard", "reservoir_hours": 12, "burst_cap": 0.15, "cooldown_s": 60, "prewarm_min_gpus": 40 }
```

mira: can someone run sim with 2.2x trace and reservoir_hours=12 vs 8? I'd like GPU-hours delta and p95 latency for both.

alex_k: i'll run sim this afternoon. Running locally with `./tools/simulate_load --trace holiday_2.2x.json --policy holiday-guard`.

devops-bot: job 98321 queued to eng-infra-sim-cluster. ETA results ~45m.

sam_t: also add a fallback to model-compact variants for steady degrade — reduces GPU token cost by ~28% for long tails.

mira: good call. Add rollout plan: 1) sim + cost diff, 2) canary apply to us-west1 small subset (10% traffic) for 2h, 3) monitor p95 and failed requests, rollback if p95>+20%.

jordan_p: I'll draft the canary routing rule to avoid eu-west1 egress windows.

finance_ella: approve up to $55k for reservations if sims show <10% quality regress.

alex_k: results in: reservoir=12 -> GPU-hours delta +14% (vs baseline) but p95 latency reduced 8% on peak; reservoir=8 -> GPU-hours +9% but p95 unchanged and more tail errors. I'll upload full logs.

mira: thanks — looks like reservoir=12 + burst_cap=15% is the winner. Plan: implement policy tonight with canary in us-west1 at 23:00 PST. Owners: alex_k (deploy), jordan_p (routing), sam_t (monitoring).

sam_t: I'll add temporary alert thresholds: p95>600ms, pending>500, failed_requests>1%.

devops-bot: deploy job 98402 started for holiday-guard policy canary.

mira: thumbs up. Post canary results in this thread. :thumbsup:

alex_k: noted — will report back with canary metrics + cost delta.

finance_ella: keep me looped if estimates move >10%.

mira: thanks team. closing the planning window for now — followups in #eng-infra-opers if anything spikes.
